provenance: ports of stan-dev/math stan/math/prim/prob/{multi_normal_cholesky,lkj_corr,lkj_corr_cholesky}_lpdf and stan/math/prim/constraint/cholesky_corr_constrain (BSD-3-Clause); every value cross-checked independently; ArviZ 1.3.0 for PSIS-LOO

invalid: size mismatch between y, mu and L
NaN or Inf in y or mu

lkj.checks: K=2 constant against the Beta form; K=3 density integrates to 1 (Monte Carlo, 4 se); testHalf identity of Stan's lkj_corr_test
lkj.note: eta == 1 has its own closed form for the constant (Lewandowski, Kurowicka, Joe 2009, thm 5)

cholesky_corr_transform.definition: z = tanh(y); row i of L built from z with L[i,i] = sqrt(1 - sum of squares); log_jacobian = sum log1m(z^2) + sum over off-first-column entries of 0.5*log1m(sum_sqs)
cholesky_corr_transform.properties: L lower triangular, positive diagonal, unit row norms (L L^T has unit diagonal); round trip via cholesky_corr_free to 1e-10

linear_algebra.gradient_rule: adjoint of values[g] accumulates the adjoints of every position i with index[i] == g

psis_loo.reference: ArviZ 1.3.0 az.loo (PSIS, Vehtari et al. 2024 'Pareto smoothed importance sampling'); tolerance 1e-6 on elpd and k. Last observation is an outlier and must get k > 0.7.

power_scaling.reference: ArviZ 1.3.0 az.psense (Kallioinen, Paananen, Buerkner, Vehtari 2024, Statistics and Computing 34): cumulative Jensen-Shannon distance between the posterior and its power-scaled versions, by PSIS reweighting, divided by |log alpha|; tolerance 1e-6
power_scaling.diagnosis_rule: both above threshold: prior-data conflict; only likelihood: fine; only prior: strong prior or weak likelihood
